_doc: Re-ranking, exact (stdlib). A fast bi-encoder returns a top-5 with the true doc (graded gain 3) buried at rank 4; a slow-but-accurate cross-encoder re-scores the SAME 5 and lifts it to rank 1. nDCG@5 0.49 → 1.00, MRR 0.33 → 1.00, recomputed from graded gains + ranks (DCG=Σ gain/log2(rank+1), nDCG=DCG/IDCG; MRR=1/rank of first relevant). The cross-encoder reorders the bi-encoder's shortlist — you pay its cost on only k candidates, not the whole corpus.
_source: _research/gen_l10.py (toy, stdlib): nDCG=DCG/IDCG over gains+ranks; MRR=1/rank of first relevant.
